traits.name: Natural Resilience
traits.text:
A life away from the pleasures of
society has made the soldier tougher than an
ordinary individual. It has advantage on Constitution
and Strength saving throws.

traits.name: Inspirational Presence
traits.text:
Allies within 60 feet of the elder that
can see it gain a +1 bonus to all attack and damage rolls. (This
bonus cannot exceed +1, even if multiple veterans are
present.)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The soldier makes two glaive attacks.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10
ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range
30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing
damage.
